premises.text: A human personal stylist searches fashion items on the user's behalf and delivers shoppable links to the inbox
premises.evidence_span: your very own personal stylist, a human being that will be behind the computer searching the item on your behalf

premises.text: A fashion social network lets users follow others and shop what they are searching when they have no image to start from
premises.evidence_span: you can follow people that you like, and you can shop what they're searching and the results

premises.text: In-house image recognition plus business rules that override tech failures, with personal styling then community as layered fallbacks so the user is never left down
premises.evidence_span: If automated fails, you can then counter the personal styling. If the personal styling fails, you can then count on the community

premises.text: Monetization is affiliate commission of 6% on sales with retailer partners already onboard
premises.evidence_span: we work as an affiliate with commission of 6% on sales

value.text: Users always get usable fashion finds because automation, stylists, or community cover each other when one path fails
value.evidence_span: our promise is to never let the user down
